The CATL-backed Choco-SEB battery swap network deployed its 2,000th swapping station June 30th, wrapping up another month of incredibly rapid growth that’s seen the company average more than 200 deployments in
month of 2026. (!)
As America celebrates its 250th birthday, EV battery giant CATL is reaching a major operational milestone, having deployed its 2,000th battery swap station on June 30th as it charges towards its larger, stated goal of having 3,000 stations fully up and running across the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong by the end of 2026.
CATL first announced that it had co-developed 10 new electric vehicle models with domestic automakers that use its swappable batteries last December
, as part of a bid to drive a trend that the company hopes will replace up to a third of the gas stations in China.
As of Wednesday, the company’s network of battery swap stations covered 180 cities across 31 provinces in China alone, with many more coming online quickly in Western markets as well,
thanks to CATL’s newly announced partnership with companies like Octopus Energy committed to bringing large-scale battery swapping to UK and European markets
“Battery swapping will be a significant part of the future of commercial transport,” said Dr. Robin Zeng, chairman and CEO of CATL,
in a statement
. “We have field-proven this technology in China, and we are delighted to bring it to the UK and Europe as part of our joint venture with Octopus.”
Choco-SEB’s latest expansion targeted a diverse range of urban markets, tourist spots, and commercial districts, and the company is reportedly preparing to enter new major routes like Beijing-Harbin, Beijing-Kunming, Beijing-Tibet, Daqing-Guangzhou, and Lanzhou-Haikou expressways.
If the current pace holds, CATL will have more than 4,000 battery swapping stations deployed globally by the end of 2026,
up from ~700 stations last October and ZERO
(0) at the start of 2025, proving once again that great things are possible with enough goodwill and corporate collaboration.

entries.b:
A Chinese satellite engine has reportedly broken a record for 14 hours of continuous thrust in orbit, Chinese media reports. The engine was able to produce 169 pounds-force (750 Newtons) of thrust, and fired for a total of 3.2 hours over 5 manoeuvres over a total of 14 hours.
For reference, the satellite was launched on June 23 on board a Long March-7A from Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site, Hainan Province, China.
The satellite’s (
Communications Technology Experiment Satellite 26A
) test took place during the satellite’s maiden flight in June. This test has now safely put the satellite in a stable Earth orbit of around 22,000 miles (35,800 km) from its delivery elliptical transfer orbit.
Engines of this kind are used to perform the final leg of satellite deployment once it is delivered to space from Earth. This is a bit like you needing to take a taxi from an airport to your final destination.
Such engines are also used to make small final corrections once in position. They can also be used to keep the satellite in orbit over the years, or potentially relocate the satellite later down the line.
The thrust of the engine doesn’t sound like much when compared to a rocket engine (typically in the kilonewton range), but once outside of Earth’s atmosphere, you don’t need that much to get around.

The technology that could replace radio communication in space
Once in space, there is no air resistance, and objects are already travelling at around 17,448 mph (7.8 km/s) thanks to Earth’s existing orbital velocity. This means that even small, continuous pushes in thrust can be enough to make changes in orbital position.
recent test,
the satellite engine’s test is significant, as such engines must work flawlessly in a vacuum without any possible need for repair or recovery. They must also operate at extremely high temperatures and restart multiple times without incident.
Chinese state media claims that the recent test has now left its US rivals “far behind” too. However, even a cursory glance at the claims shows this is a little overegged.
The claim is likely meant to refer to the engines’ designed total endurance of around 14 hours tops. For reference, most existing engines are designed for around 7 hours of total endurance.
However, the recent test only ran the engine for a total of 3.2 hours, not 14. Total endurance of an engine is also not the only metric that matters anyway.
Engineers care much more about the fuel efficiency of an engine, its reliability, mass, cost, and thrust-to-weight ratio. So, in other words, one particular engine can be better in one area while worse in another.
But perhaps the most interesting aspect of this news is the potential military applications for this new engine. More capable engines of this kind could easily be militarized to allow military satellites to reach orbit much more quickly.
They could also enable them to carry more payload instead of fuel, and be able to manoeuvre in orbit much more easily for threat avoidance or repositioning purposes.
So, while certain claims about the recent test appear to be hyperbolic, this is genuinely an impressive technical achievement for the team behind it. What’s more, the technology appears to have been mostly domestically produced, meaning
Chinese space research
is making moves to reduce its reliance on imported technologies.

entries.t: 多环芳烃自由基阴离子介导的有机碱金属插层实现秒级高质量二维晶体剥离

entries.as: 报道了基于多环芳烃自由基阴离子介导有机碱金属插层的秒级剥离技术，实现高质量二维晶体的规模化制备。现有自上而下和自下而上方法在质量与产量间存在权衡，该插层剂对石墨、MoS2等多种层状材料实现高效插层，数秒内完成剥离，所得纳米片具有大横向尺寸、高单层率的特点，为二维材料产业化提供了可扩展方案。

entries.b: Scalable production of high-quality 2D nanosheets remains challenging because existing top-down and bottom-up methods typically face a trade-off between material quality, yield, and cost. Here, we report the seconds-scale (~12 s) production of high-quality 2D crystals via polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon radical anion (PAH•-)-mediated organoalkali intercalation. The tunable reduction potential and electron-transfer capability of PAH•- enable ultrafast alkali-ion intercalation within seconds in the stable potential of layered hosts. For graphite, sodium naphthalenide (Na-Naph) forms a stage-1 graphite intercalation compound in only 1 s, and subsequent hydrolysis-driven exfoliation in 11 s yields graphene with >88% yield and >50% single-layer ratio, with a negligible increase in defect density (ID/IG ratio from ~0.10 to ~0.11). This strategy is further extended to the exfoliation of few-layer (3-5 layers) transition-metal sulfides, selenides, and tellurides while preserving their intrinsic crystal phases. This work establishes a practical, high-yield route for rapid intercalation-driven exfoliation, offering a scalable platform for manufacturing high-quality 2D crystals.

entries.t: 柔性三维共价有机框架中热响应与氙触发门控开孔实现选择性氙捕获
entries.a: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
entries.c: 通用技术/材料工程/其它先进材料
entries.as: 报道了一种柔性三维共价有机框架（COF），具有温度响应与氙气触发的开门效应，实现氙气的选择性捕获。该COF通过动态骨架呼吸行为，在特定条件下打开孔道选择性吸附Xe分子，而对Kr等相似尺寸气体排斥。这种智能软多孔晶体材料为核废料处理中Xe/Kr分离及医用同位素纯化提供了高选择性、低能耗的新策略。
kp: [门控机制]: 热响应与氙触发开孔
[构建单元]: 柔性+刚性四面体组合
entries.b: The development of dynamically responsive soft porous crystals (SPCs) is crucial for advanced gas separation due to their stimuli-triggered structural transitions. Herein, we report a 3D covalent organic framework (FCOF-XJ) constructed from flexible tetrahedral (F-3D-Td) and rigid tetrahedral (3D-Td) building blocks, exhibiting unique temperature-dependent selective adsorption of xenon (Xe). FCOF-XJ features thermoresponsive -O-C-C-C-O- single bonds that enable temperature-dependent conformational switching. The adaptive pore structure of FCOF-XJ enables an Xe-triggered gate-opening effect, with 4 times increase of Xe adsorption and a high Xe/Kr selectivity (36.9 at 298 K, 1 bar) among porous organic materials, surpassing most of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). Breakthrough experiments reveal a defined high-purity Xe recovery window from Xe/Kr mixtures under non-ideal dynamic conditions, enabled by thermoresponsive pore-gating dynamics. This work establishes a flexible COF platform for thermoresponsive and Xe-selective capture based on guest-triggered framework gating.
